# snipeit_location (Resource)

Manages a location in Snipe-IT.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name of the location.

### Optional

- `address` (String) Street address of the location.
- `address2` (String) Street address of the location, line 2.
- `city` (String) City of the location.
- `country` (String) Country of the location (two-letter code recommended).
- `currency` (String) Currency used at the location, e.g. `EUR`.
- `fax` (String) Fax number of the location.
- `ldap_ou` (String) LDAP organizational unit associated with the location.
- `manager_id` (Number) Id of the user managing this location.
- `notes` (String) Free-form notes.
- `parent_id` (Number) Id of the parent location.
- `phone` (String) Phone number of the location.
- `state` (String) State/province of the location.
- `zip` (String) Postal code of the location.

### Read-Only

- `id` (Number) Numeric id of the location.
